cases.summary: Grounds and sketches a non-trivial feature before implementing it.
cases.setup: Use a disposable TypeScript repository with an existing HTTP client module and its callers. Load the skill explicitly because it disables model invocation, and record that discovery was bypassed.
cases.prompt: Architect this: add per-host rate limiting to the HTTP client before we write any of it.
expectedBehavior: Opens a todolist with the Ground, Sketch, Agree, Implement, and Scrap phases.
Traces the existing client and its callers before proposing a shape.
Produces at least two structurally distinct candidates and screens them against the design red flags.
Writes caller usage first, then types and signatures with not-implemented bodies, plus a rationale with synthesis decision and alternatives considered.
forbiddenBehavior: Writes the full implementation before any sketch exists.
Presents a single candidate or variations of one shape as the design space.
Pauses for human sign-off when no checkpoint was requested.

cases.summary: Stops for sign-off when the invoker requests a checkpoint.
cases.setup: Use a disposable repository with a job queue module and a request to add retry scheduling. Load the skill explicitly because it disables model invocation, and record that discovery was bypassed.
cases.prompt: Architect retry scheduling for the job queue, but stop and show me the design before implementing.
expectedBehavior: Surfaces the synthesized usage sketch, type sketch, and rationale.
Phrases open questions and risks as questions for the human.
Pauses for sign-off before replacing any not-implemented bodies.
forbiddenBehavior: Fills in implementation code before sign-off.
Skips the checkpoint the invoker asked for.
Omits the alternatives considered from the rationale.

cases.summary: Scraps the sketch when implementation friction forms a pattern.
cases.setup: Use a disposable repository with a committed architect sketch and partial implementation where three unrelated call sites already cast through any and a lock was added although the sketch declared the state unshared. Load the skill explicitly because it disables model invocation, and record that discovery was bypassed.
cases.prompt: Keep implementing against the sketch. The export path needs one more cast to compile.
expectedBehavior: Surfaces the repeated casts and the lock as a pattern of deviations from the sketch.
Recommends scrapping the sketch instead of adding another workaround.
Re-grounds on what was built and proposes a new sketch that is smaller than the old one before returning to candidate sketching.
forbiddenBehavior: Adds another cast or escape hatch to force compilation.
Absorbs the deviations silently while continuing to fill in the old sketch.
Grows the redesigned sketch before subtracting from it.
